steps.tx: Counting cells in the anterior chamber stops being guesswork once the beam shrinks to a one millimetre square. This chart grades what floats inside that tiny window, from a handful of cells at the lowest grade to a dense snowstorm at four plus. The **SUN cell grading** scale lets different examiners record the same eye in the same language at every visit. That shared scale turns flare ups and quiet spells into numbers that treatment decisions, and trials, can actually follow.
